title: One snapshot, every unit
blurb: Canonical WebTransport.prototype.getStats() starter opening a real session, decoding RTT (ms), estimatedSendRate (bits/s), and datagrams counters next to raw JSON, verifying snapshot copy semantics, and reading final stats after close().
question: What units and shape does await transport.getStats() return on an established WebTransport session, is each call a static copy, and do stats remain readable after close()?
result: On Chrome for Testing 153 behind --enable-blink-features=WebTransportStats against a local Deno 2.9.8 QUIC echo server, getStats() resolved smoothedRtt, rttVariation, minRtt (ms), estimatedSendRate (bits/s), and datagrams counters; repeated calls returned distinct unmutated objects and post-close calls resolved final stats. Unflagged Chrome 153 reported getStats absent; not verified unflagged in Chrome 160.
testedIn: Chrome for Testing 153 behind --enable-blink-features=WebTransportStats (local Deno QUIC echo server); not verified unflagged in Chrome 160
